name: contract-generated-repository-types
goal: Generated repository method-state examples compile with their supported record fields while keeping the existing four cases

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Generated app and lib CLI cases fail TS2353 because a populated-state repository example passes label through an untyped generic instance. Preserve the example result and all four method/state cases.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing scaffold case counts class cases and formats emitted files, but never compiles repository method/state examples. Strengthen that case with a virtual TypeScript compilation; add no test declaration.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Record ec1016df4e19 at b5d9fbfe57: one existing scaffold case fails TS2353 for label on RepositoryRecord; five pass. The virtual compiler reports exactly the integration defect.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Commit 8dcad2c138 initializes the existing populated-state example with typeof original. The same four generated method/state cases and authored results are retained.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Matched records ec1016df4e19 and 63944edc8630: the existing compiler case fails before repair, then all six scaffold cases pass with unchanged tests and environment.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
